name: Zerodha (enctoken)
description: Your Zerodha Kite account's market data on the charts: instruments, history and live ticks from the personal API and the Kite ticker, using a browser enctoken.

settings.label: Enctoken
settings.help: Log in at kite.zerodha.com in your browser, then copy the value of the 'enctoken' cookie. It is kept in the system credential store, never shown again and never printed to the log.

settings.label: Zerodha user ID
settings.help: Your Kite login (e.g. ABC123). Leave blank to read it from the account profile.

settings.label: Segments to serve
settings.help: Comma-separated Kite segments. Remove any your account does not have; symbols of the others are not served.

settings.label: Default product
settings.help: The product an order starts from. The order ticket picks one per order (MIS/CNC on cash, MIS/NRML on derivatives) and remembers the last pick.

settings.label: Kite personal API URL
settings.help: Base URL of Kite's personal API. Leave as-is unless you proxy it.

settings.label: Kite WebSocket URL
settings.help: Base URL of Kite's ticker stream. Leave as-is unless you proxy it.

settings.label: Instrument master URL
settings.help: Kite's public instrument CSV. Leave as-is unless you proxy it.

settings.label: Company details and logo
settings.help: Fetch sector, industry and logo from an external service for cash equities. Turn off for a large watchlist to avoid thousands of lookups on every app start.

settings.label: History request cap — minutes (days)
settings.help: Days served by one intraday history request. Kite tolerates more, but 30 keeps requests small; larger windows are split and merged automatically. Blank or bad values keep 30.

settings.label: History request cap — day charts (days)
settings.help: Days served by one day-history request. Kite's hard limit is 2000; 1900 leaves headroom. Larger windows are split and merged automatically. Blank or bad values keep 1900.

settings.label: Minimum ms between a symbol's chart updates
settings.help: 0 sends every tick (default). With a large watchlist, 100–250 ms keeps charts smooth and cuts the message rate; the order ticket and DOM still get every tick.

settings.label: Maximum chart quote updates per second
settings.help: Total budget for chart/watchlist quotes across all symbols (default 200). Stops a watchlist of thousands of symbols flooding the app. 0 disables the budget. The order ticket and DOM are not counted.

settings.label: Log REST/API to file
settings.help: Writes settings, history, books and order commands to zerodha-api.log in the plugin data folder. The enctoken is never written.

settings.label: Log WebSocket to file
settings.help: Writes stream connect/reconnect and subscription summary lines to zerodha-ws.log.

settings.label: Log verbose details
settings.help: Also logs every broker.state push and stream subscription detail to zerodha-api.log.
